affected_system: municipal buildings, distributed energy, electrification, and emissions management
alternatives: protect minimum coverage before needs-based allocation of municipal energy capital and project delivery capacity
adapt allocations using observed demand, uptake, and capacity for municipal energy capital and project delivery capacity
pair carbon, resilience, readiness, and minimum-service allocation with an explicit stop, review, and escalation rule
assumptions: Meters, fuels, tariffs, weather, occupancy, equipment, projects, and emissions factors are versioned.
Modeled energy and carbon savings remain distinct from measured post-project performance.
All alternatives, capacities, costs, effects, thresholds, and failure scenarios are proposed until bound to evidence.
baseline: retain the current distribution rule for municipal energy capital and project delivery capacity.

constraints.description: The municipal energy and building decarbonization allocate must respect declared minimum service, eligibility, capacity, and distributional safeguards.
Every released metric must retain evidence type, source lineage, geography, time, assumptions, and uncertainty.
No analytical output may bypass lawful authority, accountable human review, or an applicable appeal process.

decision_cadence: recompiled at each planning cycle and after material evidence change
decision_owner: municipal energy director and public-building portfolio manager
decision_question: How should capital, incentives, engineering, procurement, and commissioning capacity be distributed?

independence_key.binding_constraint: The municipal energy and building decarbonization allocate must respect declared minimum service, eligibility, capacity, and distributional safeguards.
independence_key.decision_object: municipal energy capital and project delivery capacity
independence_key.evidence_gate: Evidence for municipal energy capital and project delivery capacity passes documented checks for eligible denominators, group attributes, inventory, minimum-service rules, and allocation records.
independence_key.intervention_mechanism: carbon, resilience, readiness, and minimum-service allocation
independence_key.primary_outcome: qualified emissions-reduction projects without assigned capacity

intended_claim: A versioned allocate design for comparing declared alternatives affecting municipal energy capital and project delivery capacity, conditional on its evidence gate.
limitations: This library record has no city binding and therefore reports no local input, output, or recommendation.
Readiness describes explicit source and method gates; it does not certify implementation feasibility.
External domain, legal, community, security, and operational review remains outside this design artifact.

objectives.metric: qualified emissions-reduction projects without assigned capacity
distributional gap in qualified emissions-reduction projects without assigned capacity
decision claims with complete evidence lineage

prohibited_claims: Do not report allocated capital or staff as a contract, installation, commissioning, or saving.
Do not describe a design-only record as a city execution, deployment, adopted policy, or impact result.
Do not relabel proposed, estimated, simulated, optimized, or causal evidence as observed evidence.
Do not infer individual behavior, protected status, harm, or entitlement from aggregate records.

release_gate.failure_release: Release an explicit insufficient-evidence record naming missing sources, failed diagnostics, prohibited claims, and the next validation action.
release_gate.pass_condition: Evidence for municipal energy capital and project delivery capacity passes documented checks for eligible denominators, group attributes, inventory, minimum-service rules, and allocation records.

title: Allocate energy capital, incentives, and delivery capacity
transportability_risks: Climate, grids, tariffs, fuels, building codes, stock, occupancy, and finance differ.
Operational changes can confound retrofit performance comparisons.
